SERVICE EXPLAINED

What does this service involve?

Security work should start with the systems, people and information at risk. Buying a tool without clear ownership can leave gaps in configuration, alerts and response. An effective engagement identifies the controls to implement, the evidence needed and who maintains them after handover.

The engagement starts by identifying the business outcome, existing responsibilities and the changes you authorise. HeyDock then confirms suitable delivery capacity, the working window and the evidence needed to complete the task. Related licences, hardware, subscriptions and specialist services are included only where the proposal says so.

PRACTICAL SCOPE

What can be included?

The final statement of work identifies the tasks that apply to your environment.

Identity and endpoint controls

Review administrative access, multi-factor authentication, device protection and supported configurations. Any changes must account for business applications and recovery access.

Remediation and configuration

Prioritise agreed findings and document changes, testing and exceptions. Maintenance responsibilities matter: a one-time improvement does not replace ongoing patching and account management.

Readiness and specialist coordination

Certification readiness, vulnerability assessment and incident response can be discussed as distinct workstreams. Certification assessment, penetration testing or a 24-hour security operations centre are not implied by general IT support.

EXAMPLE REQUIREMENT

How a project might work.

A business with inconsistent employee onboarding can start by reviewing account approvals, administrator rights and offboarding. A scoped improvement may reduce avoidable access gaps without turning the project into an unsupported claim of complete protection.

PLANNING AND COST

What affects the scope and price?

Cost depends on the number of users, devices or sites; technical complexity; access requirements; delivery hours; travel; and the work needed before and after implementation. Provide relevant system versions and existing supplier responsibilities so the quotation can distinguish labour from licences, equipment and recurring charges.

For a well-defined task, a visit or project quotation may be appropriate. Where important dependencies are unknown, a paid assessment can produce a better implementation scope. Any response, attendance or recovery target must be explicitly agreed; requesting a service does not create an immediate support commitment.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Business cybersecurity support FAQs

Can you issue Cyber Essentials certification?+

No assessor status is claimed. Readiness assistance and an authorised certification assessment are different services.

Is round-the-clock security monitoring included?+

Only where an explicitly agreed service, qualified delivery team and operating arrangements provide it.

What information should we include in an enquiry?+

Describe the objective, location, affected systems, preferred timing and existing support arrangements. Do not send passwords or sensitive business records in the enquiry form.
